decisions.reason: As the firm’s highlighted electric flagship with several models, it fits the streamlined low-carbon product strategy and is likely to remain on the market.
The halogen infrared heater appears more peripheral and overlap-prone than the flagship lines, so withdrawing it would free resources for stronger core and development priorities.
Although hydrogen-ready heating may scale gradually, this flagship series supports the firm’s decarbonization direction and benefits from an early real-world reference installation.
